lines.cap: Walk into any hair-care aisle, and the labels expect you to already know your hair.
Is it 3B? Is it fine? Is it high porosity? Honestly, most of us just guess.
So we buy a product, it doesn't work, and we buy another one.
Meet StrandLab. It measures your hair with YouCam's Hair AI, and turns those numbers into exactly what to buy.
You take four photos: front, both sides, and one with your head tipped forward.
The guided camera tracks your face live, tells you out loud how to move, and clicks the photo on its own.
Every photo is auto-framed for YouCam's detectors, so you never get stuck.
Four YouCam APIs run in parallel: Hair Type, Hair Frizziness, Hair Density and Hair Length Detection.
Meanwhile, I answer what a camera can't see, like porosity.
And StrandLab checks the dew point in Mumbai, because humidity changes which ingredients actually work.
Here's my result: 3B to 3C curls, high density, and a humid week ahead.
So: rich products, hold for my curls, and skip glycerin on humid days. Every rule shows the measurement behind it.
And nothing is a black box. You can see every YouCam call, and every photo that auto-framing rescued.
Confused by any of it? The coach explains it in plain words, in 17 languages.
You can even talk to it, and have the answers read out loud.
Then, shopping. A ranked starter kit, and real product links for your own country.
Standing in a store? Just photograph the bottle's ingredient list, and StrandLab tells you if it suits your hair.
And YouCam's Hair Volume try-on shows what this routine can realistically do, right next to the ad promise.
Now, the big one for e-commerce. Any online store can add StrandLab with one line of code.
The shopper taps "Find my hair match", matches once, and every product on the page shows how well it suits them.
The store gets the result as an event. And the shopper's photos never leave StrandLab.
StrandLab is also a PWA. Install it from your browser, and it opens full screen, just like a real app.
It's on your home screen in the store aisle, uses your phone's camera, and still opens when the network drops.
No camera, or don't want to share a selfie? The no-photo check builds your plan from four picture questions.
There's bigger text, a high-contrast mode, voice in and out, and you can send your plan to your stylist instantly.
Your hair, measured by YouCam, explained in plain words, and ready for any store.
This is StrandLab. Try it free at strandlab-youcam.vercel.app
